intro: Paul AI GEO Analyzer checks how well your web pages are prepared for AI search tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, as well as classic search engines. It shows what is working, what is missing, and exactly how to fix it, even if you have no technical background.

highlights.title: Ready-to-use fixes for every recommendation
highlights.description: Each recommendation comes with a copy-and-paste fix you can hand to your team. Clear labels show whether the editorial team or your web agency should handle it, and roughly how much time it takes.

highlights.title: Clear reports you can share or print
highlights.description: Reports are easy to scan, with the most urgent items first. Printing or saving as PDF gives you a clean, multi-page document with page numbers, ready to share with decision makers.

highlights.title: See what changed since your last check
highlights.description: After you make improvements, the extension shows which issues were fixed and which new ones appeared, so you can see your progress at a glance.

highlights.title: Compare sites and track progress over time
highlights.description: Analyze several pages across a whole website, compare runs before and after a change, and spot regressions early. Overview pages make it easy to see which pages need attention first.

highlights.title: More accurate checks for real-world pages
highlights.description: Pages built with modern tools, online shops, local businesses and start pages are now judged more fairly. Many false warnings and missed content have been fixed, so scores reflect what readers and AI tools actually see.

highlights.title: Better insight into what AI crawlers see
highlights.description: The extension now checks whether AI bots can reach your content, including server and firewall blocks, and whether your text is visible without JavaScript. This helps you spot content that AI tools might never read.

highlights.title: Automated checks for teams and agencies
highlights.description: A command-line version can run the same analysis in your own workflow and stop releases that drop below a target score, so quality stays consistent over time.
